ops.en: a venomous snake of the viper family, typically with long hinged fangs used to inject venom
ops.cn: 蝰蛇；蝰科有毒蛇，通常具有可活动的长毒牙用于注入毒液

ops.en: figurative, insulting: a treacherous, malicious, or dangerous person
ops.cn: （比喻，侮辱性）阴险恶毒、危险的人

ops.en: liveliness, high spirits, animation, and energetic enthusiasm
ops.cn: 活泼；朝气；生气勃勃、精神饱满的状态

ops.en: loudly, forcefully, and insistently expressing opinions, feelings, protests, or demands
ops.cn: 大声而强烈的；高声坚持表达观点、情绪、抗议或要求的

ops.en: a state of being fashionable, popular, or widely accepted and used
ops.cn: 流行；时尚；广泛接受和使用的状态

ops.en: the prevailing fashion, style, or popular taste at a particular time
ops.cn: 时尚潮流；某一时期流行的风格或审美

ops.pattern: come into vogue / out of vogue
ops.meaning_cn: 开始流行 / 不再流行、过时

ops.en: having an extremely eager or insatiable appetite, literally for food or figuratively for reading, information, activity, or experience
ops.cn: 食欲旺盛的；（比喻）对阅读、信息、活动或经历如饥似渴的

ops.en: extremely eager, greedy, or insatiable in wanting or consuming something
ops.cn: 贪求无厌的；欲望极强、难以满足的

ops.meaning_cn: 如饥似渴的读者 / 极旺盛的食欲或欲求

ops.en: formal, archaic, or literary: to grant, reveal, or give something as a special favor or with condescension
ops.cn: （正式/古旧/文学）赐予；俯允；作为特别恩惠或带屈尊意味地给予、透露

ops.meaning_cn: （正式/古旧）把某物作为恩惠赐予某人

ops.en: to make a prolonged, loud, high-pitched cry of pain, grief, fear, or distress
ops.cn: 哀号；恸哭；因疼痛、悲伤、恐惧或痛苦发出长而高亢的哭喊

ops.en: a prolonged, loud, high-pitched cry of pain, grief, fear, or distress
ops.cn: 哀号声；长而高亢的哭喊声

ops.en: to intentionally give up, refrain from enforcing, or dispense with a right, claim, rule, fee, requirement, or privilege
ops.cn: 放弃；免除；不行使或不执行权利、主张、规则、费用、要求或特权

ops.meaning_cn: 放弃权利；免除费用/要求

ops.en: pale, weak, tired, or sickly in appearance, often through illness, exhaustion, or sadness
ops.cn: 苍白憔悴的；显得虚弱、疲倦或病恹恹的

ops.en: rare or literary: to become pale, weak, or sickly in appearance
ops.cn: （罕见/文学）变得苍白憔悴

ops.en: to decrease gradually in size, strength, intensity, influence, or importance
ops.cn: 逐渐减弱；衰退；在大小、力量、强度、影响或重要性上慢慢下降

ops.en: of the moon: to show a gradually decreasing illuminated portion after the full moon
ops.cn: （月亮）亏缺；满月后亮面逐渐缩小

ops.meaning_cn: 一时兴起；因为突然、未经计划的欲望或冲动

ops.en: the business of selling goods in large quantities to retailers or other businesses rather than directly to consumers
ops.cn: 批发；把大量商品卖给零售商或其他企业的业务

ops.en: to sell goods in large quantities, usually for resale
ops.cn: 批发；大量销售商品供转售

ops.en: at a wholesale price or in wholesale quantities
ops.cn: 以批发价；按批发数量

ops.en: figurative: large-scale, sweeping, or indiscriminate
ops.cn: （比喻）大规模的；全面的；不加区分的

ops.en: figurative: on a large scale or indiscriminately
ops.cn: （比喻）大规模地；不加区分地

ops.en: clever tricks, stratagems, or persuasive devices used to deceive, influence, or manipulate someone
ops.cn: 诡计；花招；用于欺骗、影响或操纵他人的巧妙手段

ops.en: characterized by, exposed to, or experiencing a lot of wind
ops.cn: 多风的；风大的；暴露在强风中的

ops.en: figurative, less common: verbose, long-winded, or full of empty talk
ops.cn: （比喻，较少见）冗长空泛的；喋喋不休的

ops.en: sadly thoughtful and full of longing, often for something remembered, desired, or unattainable
ops.cn: 惆怅而向往的；带着思念、渴望或对难以得到之物的忧伤

ops.en: experienced and sophisticated in practical life, or concerned with material and earthly affairs rather than spiritual matters
ops.cn: 世故的；有实际生活经验的；关注物质和尘世事务而非精神事务的

ops.en: dryly ironic, sardonic, or grimly humorous in expression, comment, or manner
ops.cn: 冷幽默的；挖苦而带讽刺意味的；苦涩诙谐的

ops.meaning_cn: 带讽刺或苦笑意味的微笑/评论/幽默感

ops.en: rare/literal: twisted, bent, or turned to one side
ops.cn: （罕见/字面）扭曲的；歪向一边的

ops.en: thread made by spinning fibers together, used for knitting, weaving, or sewing
ops.cn: 纱线；由纤维纺成、用于编织或缝纫的线

ops.en: informal: a story or tale, often long, entertaining, or exaggerated
ops.cn: （非正式）故事；常指冗长、有趣或夸张的讲述

ops.en: informal: to tell a story or spin a tale, often at length
ops.cn: （非正式）讲故事；滔滔不绝地叙述

ops.meaning_cn: 讲一个故事，常带夸张或娱乐性

ops.en: to make a short, sharp, high-pitched cry, as by an animal or person in pain, surprise, or excitement
ops.cn: 尖叫；发出短促尖利的叫声，可由动物或人因疼痛、惊讶或兴奋发出

ops.en: a short, sharp, high-pitched cry made by an animal or person
ops.cn: 短促尖叫声；动物或人发出的尖利叫声

ops.en: a person who is fanatically, intensely, or uncompromisingly devoted to a cause, belief, or goal
ops.cn: 狂热分子；对某种事业、信念或目标极端而不妥协地投入的人

ops.value: Lowercase zealot is the ordinary common noun. Capitalized Zealot/Zealots is the historical Jewish group in Roman Judea and remains case-bounded history/reference truth.

ops.en: astronomy: the point in the sky directly above an observer
ops.cn: （天文学）天顶；观察者正上方的天空点

ops.en: figurative: the highest point or peak of success, power, influence, achievement, or development
ops.cn: （比喻）顶峰；成功、权力、影响、成就或发展的最高点

ops.en: the process of forming a general idea by focusing on common or essential properties and leaving out specific details
ops.cn: 抽象；通过提取共同或本质属性、忽略具体细节形成一般概念的过程

ops.en: an abstract concept, representation, or idea separated from concrete details or instances
ops.cn: 抽象概念；脱离具体细节或实例的概念性表述

ops.en: the academic world or community of universities, scholars, teaching, and research
ops.cn: 学术界；由大学、学者、教学和研究活动构成的学术共同体

ops.en: the process or result of adjusting to new conditions, circumstances, or an environment
ops.cn: 适应；对新条件、环境或情境进行调整的过程或结果

ops.en: a work changed from one medium, form, or source into another, such as a film or stage version of a book
ops.cn: 改编作品；把书等原作转换为电影、舞台剧等另一媒介或形式的作品

ops.en: the quality or degree of being sufficient or satisfactory for a particular need, purpose, or standard
ops.cn: 充分性；足够程度；满足特定需要、目的或标准的程度

ops.en: a person who manages, organizes, or oversees the affairs of an organization, institution, system, department, or estate
ops.cn: 管理人员；负责组织、机构、系统、部门或遗产事务管理的人

ops.en: technical or formal: relating to feelings, moods, emotions, or emotional responses
ops.cn: （专业/正式）情感的；与情绪、心境或情感反应有关的

ops.value: affective = relating to emotion or feeling; effective = successful or producing the intended result. Keep them distinct.

ops.en: the act or process of distributing or assigning money, resources, duties, space, or other items according to a plan
ops.cn: 分配；按计划分派金钱、资源、职责、空间等的过程

ops.en: an amount, share, quantity, or resource that has been allocated to someone or something
ops.cn: 分配额；已分配给某人或某用途的一份金额、份额或资源

ops.meaning_cn: 一笔分配的资金/一份资源配额
由于预期某事会发生；为预期中的事情提前做准备

ops.en: understanding or recognition of the nature, significance, quality, or value of something
ops.cn: 理解；认识；对某事物性质、意义、品质或价值的体会

ops.en: gratitude, thanks, or recognition of someone's help, effort, or good qualities
ops.cn: 感激；感谢；对帮助、努力或优点的认可

ops.en: an increase in the monetary or market value of an asset, property, or currency
ops.cn: 升值；资产、房产或货币价值的增加

ops.en: the process or result of evaluating, judging, or estimating quality, amount, ability, risk, performance, or a situation
ops.cn: 评估；评价；对质量、数量、能力、风险、表现或局势作出判断的过程或结果
